title: How to Send Money from the US to India: Compare the Real Cost
seo_title: Send Money from the US to India: Compare Real Cost
meta_description: Learn how to compare money transfers from the US to India by final INR received, exchange rate, fees, delivery method, timing and sender protections.
excerpt: The cheapest advertised fee does not identify the best transfer. Compare live quotes using the same payment and payout methods, then check the final INR, timing and cancellation terms before paying.
